at -2.6 %.
• Banking assets registered annual growth rate of 12.6% to FRw 4,854 trillion in September 2021 from FRw 4,310 trillion in December 2020.
• The Insurance Sector registered a growth rate of 11.8%% to FRw 661.8 billion in September 2021 FRw from 591.7 billion in December 2020.
